newsitem.title: USA: Gingrich threatens to halt aid to Palestinians.
newsitem.headline: Gingrich threatens to halt aid to Palestinians.

text.p: House Speaker Newt Gingrich threatened on Tuesday to block U.S. aid to the Palestinian Authority, saying its leaders were behaving like Nazis by threatening to kill Arabs who sold land to Israelis.

"The Palestinians must be on notice that these senseless acts must stop. The vigilante murder of realtors by Palestinian security officials is an egregious violation of human rights and of international norms," Gingrich, leader of the Republican majority in the House of Representatives, said.

Gingrich added: "The killing must be renounced by the Palestinian leadership and end immediately. If not, I for one will actively oppose the continuation of any aid to the Palestinian authority. This is the kind of action we identify with Nazis."
Gingrich's statement was greeted with applause from other members.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has alleged the Palestinian Authority has ties to three recent killings of Arabs suspected of selling land to Jews. Israeli police have said they are holding at least four Palestinian security officials believed to have been involved in the killings. Palestinian security officials have denied involvement.
But Palestinian Justice Minister Freih Abu Medeen was quoted on May 4 as saying Palestinians who sold land to Jews faced execution.
